content:
deploy-bot: Promotion halted — artifact verification failed during staging publish (ci-image-build #789).
rachel: CI log shows `ETag mismatch` for multipart upload part=4, followed by 403 on commit.
ben: saw a concurrent cache-pruner job hit runners ~45s before the upload started. Possible race where partials were being GC'd?
maya: pasted job snippet: `ERROR upload: multipart commit failed, status=403, body=Forbidden`
sam: can we re-run the upload step isolated (no rebuild) to see if it's transient? re-run would be quicker than full rebuild.
ira: for this release window I'd prefer a safer approach: pin to the last-known-good registry digest and proceed with canary, then investigate.
rachel: agree. pinning is low-risk since this is just an image manifest change and no DB schema involved. I'll craft the release note.
deploy-bot: Auto-promote disabled by policy when artifact verification fails :warning:
ben: operational plan: 1) abort current staging promotion attempts; 2) apply pin to sha256:fa1e22b7d; 3) run smoke tests; 4) schedule background full rebuild with --no-cache and increased S3 retries (INF-3922).
maya: opening INF-3922 now to track multipart retry and GC timing. tagging s3-team and infra.
sam: starting isolated re-upload job on runner r21 to attempt commit-only (job 792).
rachel: release notes draft: "Temporary pin to last-known-good image sha256:fa1e22b7d due to CI artifact commit failures. No code or migration changes."
ira: if isolated re-upload succeeds, we can unblock without pin. if it fails, pin stays for change window.
deploy-bot: Manual promote command available: `/deploy promote --env=staging --image=sha256:fa1e22b7d`
ben: promote kicked off. Promote job 5941.
sam: isolated commit-only job returned 403 as well. logs uploaded -> /logs/ci/792/multipart-403.log
maya: huh. both rebuild and commit-only failing suggests an S3-side permission or regional transient. SRE please run region connectivity + auth check.
ira: SRE pinged. also increasing client retries as a temporary mitigation.
rachel: staging smoke on pinned digest started; running smoke-quick suite (~6 checks).
ben: background full rebuild with --no-cache is running but deprioritized; lets not block the window if smoke passes.
sam: smoke-quick passed on pinned image :white_check_mark:
ira: consensus: keep pinned image for the change window, delay prod promote until INF-3922 root cause resolved and SRE confirms S3 health.
maya: updating cut notes and informing PMs. adding runbook entry for manual rollback to previous digest if needed.
deploy-bot: Thread closed by @rachel after pin decision and stakeholder notification.
